text:
incident-bot: ALERT: gpu-pool-primary-us-east queue length hit 18,200 (SLO breach risk). Autoscaler attempts failing: \"scaleup blocked: quota_exceeded\". Throttling rising, 5xx/429 spike. Pager duty sent to oncall.
alice.nguyen: I'm on it — pulling autoscaler logs now. tagging @ben.ortiz for routing config.
ben.ortiz: seeing repeated 403 from cloud quota API in autoscaler logs. looks like quota check fails, so desiredReplica not applied. short log snip: ```2026-03-15T03:12:34Z ERROR scaler.go:142 scaleUp failed: quota_exceeded: requested 8 GPUs, available 0``` 
carol: customer-facing metrics show increased token queue wait time for several high-TPS customers (ids: C-981, C-121). adding to impact log.
dinesh: can we bump a reserve pool? reserved capacity still has some headroom in us-west2.
eve_ops: quick mitigation options: 1) enable cross-region spillover to us-west2, 2) fall back to a smaller model variant for non-critical customers, 3) manually force extra nodes (if quota allows) — #1 lowest code risk.
oncall-uk: I'm the current pager, on the call. If we enable spillover, need to update routing to avoid cold-start storm on west region.
alice.nguyen: agreed. Ben, can you flip the routing policy to allow regional spillover with gradual ramp (10% increments) and enable prefix caching to reduce cold-start pressure?
ben.ortiz: doing it now — pushing change to routing service. command I used: ```curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/routing/policies -H 'Authorization: Bearer **' -d '{"policy":"spillover","from":"us-east1","to":"us-west2","ramp":0.1}'``` 
ben.ortiz: policy accepted by routing API, initiating 10% spillover.
incident-bot: NOTE: routing change applied at 03:15:06Z. watching downstream metrics for spike.
carol: initial drop in us-east1 queue to 14k, us-west2 queue jumping but healthy so far. token latency for high-priority customers stabilized.
dinesh: autoscaler still 403 on quota calls. filing a quota ticket with cloudsquad in parallel: https://cloud.example/tickets/INC-6421
alice.nguyen: we should also enable degraded-model fallback for background customers. applying eval config now.
ben.ortiz: toggled model fallback for customer group 'background' -> variant-lite. config push: ```PUT /service/v1/configs/fallback {"group":"background","variant":"lite","enabled":true}```
eve_ops: monitoring errors: 429s went from 2.4% -> 0.7% over the last 6m after spillover + fallback. good sign.
oncall-uk: handing to eu-night oncall in 30m; leaving notes. please call me if things regress.
alice.nguyen: opening a short-lived manual scale attempt to test quota boundary: ```kubectl patch gpupool gpu-primary-us-east -p '{"spec":{"manualOverrideReplicas":4}}'``` — success? 
ben.ortiz: patch applied but cloud API returns quota_exceeded on node provisioning. patch accepted locally but nodes not provisioned.
dinesh: cloudsquad responded: quota increase request queued, ETA ~2 hours. they suggested adding preemptible alternative but that would change perf profile.
carol: customer-impact update: C-981 saw 503s for ~3 minutes during the initial surge, then degraded to slower but successful responses for subsequent requests. C-121 experienced delayed embeddings for a 7-minute window. logging this for postmortem.
eve_ops: next step: increase spillover ramp to 40% to relieve pressure while we wait for quota. if west gets cold-start spike, we have prefix cache.
alice.nguyen: doing incremental ramp now: 10% -> 25% -> 40%. I’m watching cold-start success rate and cache hit ratio.
incident-bot: ramp to 40% applied at 03:28:40Z. Cache warmers triggered for top prefixes.
ben.ortiz: west cache warmers report 85% hit after 90s, cold-starts minimal.
oncall-uk: logs show drop in us-east1 queue to 3.2k as of 03:33Z. throttling rates down to baseline.
dinesh: opened a temporary GRACE rule to prevent routing back to us-east1 for large-batch jobs until autoscaler is healthy.
alice.nguyen: creating an incident summary for customers: brief outage window, steps taken, next steps (quota request, infra changes). tagging @pagerduty to attach to incident ticket.
pagerduty: Ticket INC-31245 created and assigned to infra-quotas. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/INC-31245
carol: immediate mitigation successful. root cause likely sudden quota depletion from unrelated provisioning earlier + autoscaler not retrying gracefully on quota errors. will add retry/backoff and a fail-open to routing decisions on next patch.
alice.nguyen: proposed postmortem actions: 1) autoscaler: treat quota_exceeded as transient with exponential backoff + enqueue fallback, 2) routing: automated spillover aggressiveness metric, 3) runbook: explicit step to bump spillover before manual scale, 4) request a quota buffer for primary pools.
oncall-uk: handing incident to eu-night oncall (eve_ops) for overnight watch. timestamped notes in channel. will be available for re-escalation.
eve_ops: ack — monitoring set, alert thresholds lowered, will escalate if queue > 5k or 5xx > 1%.
alice.nguyen: thanks everyone — marking this thread monitored and adding to postmortem queue. closing mitigation loop now.
incident-bot: RESOLVED/monitoring: queue stable, throttles plateaued under SLO threshold at 03:45:10Z. Please file postmortem within 72h.
